'''Anuška Ferligoj''' is a [[Slovenians|Slovenian]] [[mathematician]], born August 19, 1947, in [[Ljubljana]], [[Slovenia]], whose specialty is [[statistics]] and [[Social network analysis|network analysis]]. Her specific interests include [[multivariate analysis]] (theory and application in social sciences, medicine, etc.), [[cluster analysis]] (constraints, multi-criteria clustering), [[social network analysis]] (blockmodeling, reliability and [[validity (statistics)|validity]] of network measurement), methodological research of [[public opinion]], analysis of scientific networks. She is a professor emeritus at the [[University of Ljubljana]], [[Slovenia]].<ref name="fdv.uni-lj">{{cite web|url=https://www.fdv.uni-lj.si/en/research/research-centres/department-of-sociology/centre-for-methodology-and-informatics/news/prof.-dr.-anu%C5%A1ka-ferligoj-awarded-with-the-title-professor-emeritus-of-university-of-ljubljana |title=Dr. Anuška Ferligoj awarded with the title Professor Emeritus of University of Ljubljana. |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-12-12 |title=Anuška Ferligoj: »Statistika ne laže. Kaže družbo, kakršna je v resnici« |url=https://www.dnevnik.si/novice/slovenija/anuska-ferligoj-statistika-ne-laze-kaze-druzbo-kakrsna-je-v-resnici-2186085/ |access-date=2025-07-12 |website=www.dnevnik.si |language=sl}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Ferligoj obtained her B.S. in [[mathematics]] and [[physics]] in 1971, and her M.S. in [[operational research]] in 1979 from the [[University of Ljubljana]]. In 1983 she obtained her Ph.D. in [[information science]] from the same university under the supervision of Professor Branislav Ivanović.<ref name="cv">{{cite web|url=http://vladowiki.fmf.uni-lj.si/lib/exe/fetch.php?media=nusa:pdf:cv_aferligoj.pdf |title=Anuška Ferligoj. European Curriculum Vitae. |access-date=22 August 2021}}</ref><ref name="teachers/info"/>

== Career ==
Since 1972, Ferligoj was employed as [[Teaching assistant|assistant]], [[assistant professor]], [[associate professor]] and finally from 1994 as full [[professor]] at the Faculty of Social Sciences.<ref name="teachers/info">{{cite web|url=https://www.fdv.uni-lj.si/en/news-and-information/contacts/teachers/info/anuska-ferligoj#zivljenjepis |title=Dr. Anuška Ferligoj, Professor Emeritus. University of Ljubljana, Faculty of Social Sciences. |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref> In 2003–2005, she was the dean of the [[Faculty of Social Sciences, Ljubljana|Faculty of Social Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fdv.uni-lj.si/en/home |title=University of Ljubljana, Faculty of Social Sciences. |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref> In 1992–2012, she was the head of the Centre for Methodology and Informatics at the Institute of Social Sciences.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fdv.uni-lj.si/en/research/research-centres/department-of-sociology/centre-for-methodology-and-informatics |title=Centre for Methodology and Informatics. University of Ljubljana, Faculty of Social Sciences. |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref> In 2002–2013, she headed the graduate program on statistics, and in 2012–2020 the master program on applied [[statistics]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://fri.uni-lj.si/en/study-programme/applied-statistics |title=Applied Statistics. Masters programme. University of Ljubljana. |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref> She has been a [[professor emeritus]] there since 2020.<ref name="fdv.uni-lj"/>

She was a [[Fulbright scholar]] in 1990—1991<ref name="fulbrightdirectories">{{cite web|url=https://libraries.uark.edu/specialcollections/fulbrightdirectories/MC703_CIES_Box91_1990-91_Volume_1.pdf |title=Fulbright Scholars Directory. 1990-1991, Volume 1, p.80. |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref> and visiting professor at the [[University of Pittsburgh]] (1996) and at the [[University of Vienna]] (2009/10).<ref name="cv"/> She was awarded the title of [[Ambassador of Science of the Republic of Slovenia]] in 1997.<ref name="Five">{{cite web|url=https://english.sta.si/285721/five-science-ambassadors-of-slovenia |title=Five Science Ambassadors of Slovenia |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref>

==Academic service==
Ferligoj chaired the Statistical Society of Slovenia in 1982 – 1983.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://stat-d.si/home/organi-drustva/ |title=Statistično društvo Slovenije. Organi društva. |date=April 2019 |access-date=22 August 2021}}</ref>
She was the president of the Statistical Council of the Republic of Slovenia (2007–2021)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.stat.si/statweb/en/NationalStatistics/StatCouncil |title=Republic of Slovenia. Statistical Office. Statistical Council. |access-date=23 August 2021}}</ref> and a member of the European Statistical Advisory Committee (ESAC) (2011–2015).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://eu.vlex.com/vid/commission-decision-of-16september-843360685 |title=Commission Decision of 16 September 2010 appointing two members of the European Statistical Advisory Committee Text with EEA relevance |access-date=23 August 2021}}</ref>

She was founding editor of the journal Advances in Methodology and Statistics (''[[Metodološki zvezki]]'') in 1987 – 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://stat-d.si/mz/|title=Metodološki zvezki – Advances in Methodology and Statistics. Editorial board. Founding Editors|access-date=23 August 2021|archive-date=19 August 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210819102137/https://stat-d.si/mz/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==
Ferligoj twice received awards of Statistical Society of Slovenia – in 1997, and in 2012 (Marijan Blejec award<ref>{{cite web|url=https://stat-d.si/aktivnosti/priznanja/ |title=Statistično društvo Slovenije. Priznanja. |work=Statistično društvo Slovenije |trans-title=Statistical Society of Slovenia. Acknowledgments. |language=sl |date=30 April 2019 |access-date=22 August 2021}}</ref>).

The book ''Generalized Blockmodeling'' that she coauthored received Harrison White Outstanding Book Award by Mathematical Sociology Section of the American Sociological Association in 2007.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.asanet.org/asa-communities/asa-sections/current-sections/mathematical-sociology/mathematical-sociology-award-recipient-history |title=American Sociological Association. Mathematical Sociology Award Recipient History. The Section on Mathematical Sociology's Harrison White Outstanding Book Award. |access-date=22 August 2021}}</ref> Jointly with Vladimir Batagelj, she received Simmel award from the International Network for Social Network Analysis.<ref name="Simmel Award">{{cite web|url=https://www.insna.org/simmel-award |title=International Network for Social Network Analysis. Simmel Award. |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref>

In 2007 and 2008, students at the Faculty of Social Science chose her as the best professor.<ref name="teachers/info"/> She received Doctor et Professor Honoris Causa at Eötvös Loránd University in Budapest in 2010,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.elte.hu/dstore/document/2979/ELTE_diszdoktorok_EN.pdf |title=Eötvös Loránd University. Honorary Doctors of ELTE. 1847 – 2018, p.27. |access-date=22 August 2021}}</ref> and Golden Plaque of University of Ljubljana in 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uni-lj.si/aktualno/novice/2013120313421702/ |title=Slavnostna Seja Senata Univerze v Ljubljani 2013. |trans-title=Ceremonial Session of the Senate of the University of Ljubljana 2013. |language=sl |access-date=22 August 2021}}</ref>

She is an elected member of the European Academy of Sociology<ref name="European Academy of Sociology">{{cite web|url=http://www.european-academy-sociology.eu/fellows/ferligoj.html |title=European Academy of Sociology–Fellows. Dr. Anuška Ferligoj |access-date=24 August 2021}}</ref> and [[International Statistical Institute]].<ref name="ISI">{{cite web |url=https://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/who-is-isi/members/indivual |title=International Statistical Institute. Individual Members. |access-date=24 August 2021 |archive-date=5 October 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211005043450/https://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/who-is-isi/members/indivual |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Selected bibliography ==
Ferligoj is an author of scientific papers in the international journals in the field of methodology, statistics and social network analysis, and chapters in the monographs. Her most important books include: 
* [[Patrick Doreian]], [[Vladimir Batagelj]], Anuška Ferligoj, [[Mark Granovetter]] (Series Editor), ''Generalized Blockmodeling'' (Structural Analysis in the Social Sciences), Cambridge University Press 2004 ({{ISBN|0-521-84085-6}})
* Anuška Ferligoj, Rener, T., & Ule, M. 1990. ''Ženska, zasebno, politično ali" Ne vem, sem neodločena". Znanstveno in publicistično središče''. URL: [https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/441332582]
* Anuška Ferligoj. 1995, 1997. ''Osnove statistike na prosojnicah. Samozaložba''. URL: [https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/441940285]
* Ferligoj, A., Leskošek, K., & Kogovšek, T. 1995. ''Zanesljivost in veljavnost merjenja. Fakulteta za družbene vede''. URL: [http://mrvar.fdv.uni-lj.si/pub/mz/mz11/mz11.pdf]
* Blaženka, K., Franc, A., Alojzija, D. U., Anuška, F., & Matjaž, O. 1994, 2001. ''Statistični terminološki slovar''. Ljubljana: Statistično društvo Slovenije: Statistični urad Republike Slovenije. URL: [https://www.worldcat.org/oclc/445316398]
* [[Vladimir Batagelj]], Anuška Ferligoj, & Žiberna, A. (Editors). ''Data Science and Classification'', Springer, 2006. URL: [https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9783540344155]
* [[Vladimir Batagelj]], [[Patrick Doreian]], Anuška Ferligoj, & Kejžar, N. 2014. ''Understanding large temporal networks and spatial networks: Exploration, pattern searching, visualization and network evolution''. John Wiley & Sons. URL: [https://www.wiley.com/en-ar/Understanding+Large+Temporal+Networks+and+Spatial+Networks%3A+Exploration%2C+Pattern+Searching%2C+Visualization+and+Network+Evolution-p-9780470714522]
* [[Patrick Doreian]], [[Vladimir Batagelj]], & Anuška Ferligoj (Editors). ''Advances in Network Clustering and Blockmodeling''. John Wiley & Sons, 2020. URL: [https://www.wiley.com/en-us/Advances+in+Network+Clustering+and+Blockmodeling-p-9781119224709]
* ResearcherId: [http://www.researcherid.com/rid/A-3675-2009 A-3675-2009]
